acceptance_criteria: Recurring work has named accepted ownership, measurable review and source budgets, and explicit decision records.
Expansion does not weaken evidence, rights or compatibility gates to inflate record counts.
risks: Incorrect admission could publish unsupported information.
completion_evidence: Reviewed implementation/decision commit and PR at the accepted revision.
Actual receipts for every acceptance criterion; synthetic, live-source and deployed evidence labeled separately.
Required affected-owner and independent-review decisions.
definition_of_done: All listed acceptance criteria met at exact artifact/source revisions.
Relevant negative and failure cases pass with retained receipts.
Documentation and scope mappings updated.
No known critical rights, integrity, security or consumer compatibility defect in changed behavior.
GitHub state updated from accepted evidence, not from a planning baseline reset.
scope_exclusions: Research authority changes remain in their canonical owner repositories.
Consumer UI changes use existing receiving implementation lanes.

acceptance_criteria: All work packages have accepted outcomes or an explicitly reviewed scoped deferral.
Cross-workstream dependencies and receiving-owner decisions are recorded.
readiness_reasons: Descendant work packages have unaccepted prerequisites; aggregate status does not create additional native blocker edges.
Actual implementation owners have not accepted assignments.
